leave.main_subtitle: Submit your leave request with AI assistance
leave.no_requests_desc: Your leave requests and approvals will appear here
leave.no_requests_hint: Start a conversation with the AI assistant to request leave
leave.assistant_desc: I'll help you submit your leave request step by step
leave.welcome_msg: Hi John! I'm here to help you submit your leave request. Here's what I can do:
leave.feature_1: • Process natural language requests like "I need tomorrow off"
leave.feature_2: • Help you choose the right leave type based on your situation
leave.feature_3: • Check your balances and suggest alternatives
leave.feature_4: • Guide you through company policies and requirements
leave.feature_5: • Submit requests directly to the HR system
leave.what_help: What would you like to do today?
leave.input_placeholder: Type your leave request here... (e.g., 'I need 3 days off next week for vacation')
leave.modal_success_desc: Your leave request has been submitted and is pending approval.
leave.error_processing: I'm sorry, I'm having trouble processing your request right now. Please try again.
leave.balance_info:
Here are your current leave balances:

• Annual Leave: 15.5 days
• Sick Leave: 8.0 days
• Personal Leave: 3.0 days

You're in good shape! Is there a specific type of leave you'd like to request?
leave.tomorrow_request: I understand you need tomorrow off. Let me help you with that. I'll prepare a leave request form:
leave.vacation_clarification:
I'd be happy to help you request vacation time! To prepare the best request, could you please tell me:

• Which specific dates do you need off?
• How many days total?
• Is this for annual leave?
• Any special reason or occasion?
leave.sick_request: I understand you need sick leave. I'll prepare a sick leave request. Note that sick leave typically doesn't require advance notice if it's for today.
leave.general_request:
I understand you'd like to request leave. I can help you with that! Could you provide more details about:

• The dates you need
• Type of leave (annual, sick, personal, emergency)
• Duration (full day, half day, multiple days)
• Reason (optional but helpful)
leave.modify_prompt: What would you like to modify? You can tell me the changes and I'll update the form for you.
leave.form_cancelled: Form cancelled. What else can I help you with?
leave.submission_success:
Success! Your leave request has been submitted and added to your requests.

Request ID: {id}
Status: Pending Manager Approval
Expected Response: Within 24 hours

You can see the request details in the sidebar. You'll receive an email notification once your manager reviews the request.
leave.submission_error: I'm sorry, there was an error submitting your request. Please try again or contact HR support if the problem persists.
leave.approval_notification:
🎉 Great news! Your leave request (ID: {id}) has been approved by your manager.

You can see the updated status in the sidebar. Have a great time off!
